notes: Cash basis (modified cash), all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a governmental fund here); business_type null. Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4 of trimmed PDF; report p6). beginning_cash/ending_cash are total governmental fund balances (cash in bank plus funds held by County Treasurer). The General Fund column of the statement includes Depreciation (13,230 interest) and Employee Benefit (1,740 interest) fund receipts, which are separate schedules in the report. Transfers: General Fund transfer out 35,000 matches Activity Fund transfer in 35,000; the General Fund spending lines exclude it (statement GF disbursements 5,531,565; schedule total 5,566,565 includes the 35,000 transfer). Student Fee Fund 2 is shown as a disbursement 'Student Fees' on the statement but as 'Transfer to Activity' on its schedule. Detail: General Fund by program (no object breakdown printed, so 'not itemized'); per-account activity schedule not printed, so one-line Activities Fund schedule used; combining schedule (p5) and Exhibit statements not repeated in detail. Budget amounts printed only as fund totals, so budget_final null on General Fund lines. 'Other local receipts' 57,299 left as other (General Fund 45,248 holds rentals, license fees, contributions, court fines and non-revenue; others unexplained). Attempt 2: statement 'County fines and fees' 9,901 split into 2110 County Fines and License Fees 6,284 (Fines and Licenses) and 2210 ESU Receipts 3,617 (p6); 'State receipts' 1,720,204 checked (GF 3110-3990 lines excluding homestead/credit/pro-rate, 1,718,808, + Nutrition 1,396), no split needed; detail 1200 Special Education -> Special Education Programs; balance sheet now from the governmental funds Statement of Assets and Fund Balances p3 (Total column, fund balance by classification), whose totals equal the Statement of Net Position p1 (3,825,751). Read pages 1-15 of 15

decision_needed.question: The Student Fee Fund schedule (p15) shows its 2 as 'Transfer to Activity', but the statement (p4/p5) prints it as a Student Fees disbursement and the Activities Fund shows only the 35,000 transfer in. Is the 2 a transfer or a disbursement?
decision_needed.recorded_as: disbursements 'Student Fees' (other, review) on the statement; detail other financing -2 on the Student Fee schedule
